description: Environment setup and baseline verification. Create the feature branch and confirm the build and tests are green before any changes so the rebalance can be verified against a known-good baseline.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/kiro-digitalmonster on branch main (clean, synced with origin/main), create and check out a new branch: `git checkout -b feat/wide-layout-balance`.

Export the toolchain PATH: `export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"` (node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2 expected). Dependencies are already installed; if `npm run build` complains about missing modules, run `npm install` at the root first.
Run `npm run build` at the repo root and confirm it completes green (shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra).
Run `npm test` at the repo root and confirm shared tests pass (baseline 47/47).
Run `cd packages/frontend && npm test` and confirm the ui-helpers tests pass (baseline 55/55), then return to the repo root.
acceptance_criteria: Branch feat/wide-layout-balance exists and is checked out, created from main.
`npm run build` at root completes without errors.
`npm test` at root reports shared 47/47 passing.
findings: Baseline established on branch feat/wide-layout-balance (created from main at commit 900639f, clean/synced with origin/main). node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2 (PATH export required). Dependencies already installed; no npm install needed. `npm run build` at root GREEN: shared(tsc) -> backend(tsc) -> frontend(tsc && vite build: 53 modules, dist/index.html 0.48kB, index CSS 14.07kB, index JS 180.21kB, built in 5.43s) -> infra(tsc), exit 0. `npm test` at root: shared 47/47 pass, 0 fail (1..47). `cd packages/frontend && npm test`: ui-helpers (src/game-ui.test.ts) 55/55 pass, 0 fail (1..55). All baselines match the plan exactly (shared 47/47, frontend 55/55). No source files changed; no commit needed for this setup/verification feature.
